ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: synchronizes sequential logic (module receives clock)
ports.evidence: used in rising_edge(clk_i) in multiple processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: global reset input, async low-active (module receives reset)
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... in ctrl and status processes

ports.name: host_req_i
ports.function: host request bus input; supplies address/data/control (module receives)

ports.name: host_req_i.addr
ports.function: host request address input (module receives address)

ports.name: host_req_i.data
ports.function: host request data input for writes (module receives write data)

ports.name: host_req_i.ben
ports.function: host request byte-enable input (module receives write enables)

ports.name: host_req_i.stb
ports.function: host request strobe input (valid); module receives requests

ports.name: host_req_i.rw
ports.function: host request read/write flag input (module receives R/W)

ports.name: host_req_i.src
ports.function: host request source ID input (forwarded to bus)

ports.name: host_req_i.priv
ports.function: host request privilege flag input (forwarded to bus)

ports.name: host_req_i.debug
ports.function: host debug-mode flag input; causes cache bypass (module receives)

ports.name: host_req_i.amo
ports.function: host atomic-operation flag input (module receives)

ports.name: host_req_i.amoop
ports.function: host atomic-op opcode input (forwarded to bus)

ports.name: host_req_i.lock
ports.function: host lock flag input (forwarded to bus)

ports.name: host_req_i.fence
ports.function: host fence/sync request input (module receives fence)

ports.name: host_rsp_o
ports.function: drives host response bus output (module drives responses)

ports.name: host_rsp_o.ack
ports.function: drives host response ack output (module drives ack)
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o.ack <= '1' on cache hit or in error handling

ports.name: host_rsp_o.err
ports.function: drives host response error output (module signals errors)

ports.name: host_rsp_o.data
ports.function: drives host response data output (module sends read data)

ports.name: bus_req_o
ports.function: drives bus request bus output (module issues bus requests)

ports.name: bus_req_o.addr
ports.function: bus request address output (module drives address)

ports.name: bus_req_o.data
ports.function: bus request data output (module drives write data)
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i (for data) and bus_req_o.data used for writes

ports.name: bus_req_o.ben
ports.function: bus request byte-enable output (module drives enables)

ports.name: bus_req_o.stb
ports.function: bus request strobe output (module asserts requests)
ports.evidence: bus_req_o.stb <= '1' for direct and download requests

ports.name: bus_req_o.rw
ports.function: bus request read/write output (module drives R/W flag)

ports.name: bus_req_o.src
ports.function: bus request source ID output (module forwards source)

ports.name: bus_req_o.priv
ports.function: bus request privilege flag output (module forwards privilege)

ports.name: bus_req_o.debug
ports.function: bus request debug flag output (module forwards debug)

ports.name: bus_req_o.amo
ports.function: bus request atomic-op flag output (module forwards amo)

ports.name: bus_req_o.amoop
ports.function: bus request atomic-op opcode output (module forwards amoop)

ports.name: bus_req_o.lock
ports.function: bus request lock output (module asserts locked transfers)

ports.name: bus_req_o.fence
ports.function: bus request fence output (module issues fence)
ports.evidence: bus_req_o.fence <= '1' in S_CLEAR when READ_ONLY = false

ports.name: bus_rsp_i
ports.function: bus response bus input (module receives memory responses)
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i; bus_rsp_i used to progress FSM

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.ack
ports.function: bus response ack input (module receives ack)

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.err
ports.function: bus response error input (module receives error status)

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.data
ports.function: bus response data input (module receives read data)

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: module receives asynchronous active-low reset (input)
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ctrl.state <= S_IDLE in reset branch

ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: module receives clock for synchronous updates (input)
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in control, status, tag, and data processes

ports.name: clr_i
ports.function: module receives clear-all cache command (input)

ports.name: inv_i
ports.function: module receives invalidate-block command (input)

ports.name: new_i
ports.function: module receives set-new-block command, make valid and set tag (input)

ports.name: hit_o
ports.function: module drives cache hit flag (output)
ports.evidence: hit_o <= '1' when valid_mem_rd='1' and tag_mem_rd = acc_tag else '0'

ports.name: addr_i
ports.function: module receives access address (input)
ports.evidence: acc_tag/acc_idx/acc_off are derived from addr_i bit ranges

ports.name: we_i
ports.function: module receives byte write-enable vector (input)
ports.evidence: we_i(n) gates writes: if (we_i(n)='1') then data_mem_bn(...) <= wdata_i(...)

ports.name: wdata_i
ports.function: module receives write data for cache writes (input)
ports.evidence: wdata_i slices assigned into data_mem_b0..b3 on conditional writes

ports.name: rdata_o
ports.function: module drives read data output (output)
ports.evidence: rdata_o(7..0) <= data_mem_b0(...); similarly for other bytes

signals.name: cache_o
signals.function: control interface bundle to cache memory
signals.evidence: fields assigned in ctrl_engine_comb and mapped to cache_memory ports

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_clr
signals.evidence: set '1' in S_CLEAR; mapped to cache_memory.clr_i

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_inv
signals.evidence: set '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE on ctrl.buf_err; mapped to inv_i

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_new
signals.function: command to make accessed block valid and set tag
signals.evidence: set '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ; mapped to cache_memory.new_i

signals.name: cache_o.addr
signals.evidence: default host_req_i.addr; set to ctrl.tag&idx&ofs in download states

signals.name: cache_o.data
signals.function: write data presented to cache memory
signals.evidence: default host_req_i.data; set from bus_rsp_i.data in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

signals.name: cache_o.we
signals.evidence: set from host_req_i.ben on write; (others=>'1') during download

signals.name: cache_i
signals.function: status and read-data from cache memory
signals.evidence: driven by cache_memory ports hit_o and rdata_o (instantiated component)

signals.name: cache_i.sta_hit
signals.evidence: driven by memory hit_o; used in S_LOOKUP to choose hit/miss path

signals.name: cache_i.data
signals.evidence: mapped to memory rdata_o; used as host_rsp_o.data default

signals.name: ctrl
signals.function: control FSM registers and buffered flags
signals.evidence: ctrl <= ctrl_nxt on rising_edge(clk_i) in ctrl_engine_sync

signals.name: ctrl.state
signals.evidence: set on reset and updated by ctrl <= ctrl_nxt on clock edge

signals.name: ctrl.buf_req
signals.evidence: ctrl.buf_req stored on clock; set/cleared in ctrl_engine_comb

signals.name: ctrl.buf_sync
signals.evidence: set from host_req_i.fence; used to enter S_CLEAR; stored in ctrl

signals.name: ctrl.buf_err
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err; stored in ctrl on clock

signals.name: ctrl.buf_dir
signals.evidence: set when uncached/amo/debug detected; used to select direct access

signals.name: ctrl.tag
signals.evidence: ctrl.tag assigned in S_LOOKUP and captured into ctrl on clock

signals.name: ctrl.idx
signals.evidence: ctrl.idx assigned in S_LOOKUP and captured into ctrl on clock

signals.name: ctrl.ofs
signals.function: stored word offset within cache block
signals.evidence: ctrl.ofs initialized in S_LOOKUP and incremented during S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

signals.name: ctrl_nxt
signals.evidence: assigned combinationally in ctrl_engine_comb process

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.state
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.state set in case branches inside ctrl_engine_comb

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_req
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb in ctrl_engine_comb

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence in comb

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_err
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir set when uncached/amo/debug detected in S_IDLE

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.tag
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(31 downto 32-tag_size_c) in S_LOOKUP

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.idx
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.idx <= host_req_i.addr((offset_size_c+2+index_size_c)-1 downto offset_size_c+2)

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.ofs
signals.function: next offset value to capture or increment
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.ofs set to zeros in S_LOOKUP and incremented during download

signals.name: valid_mem
signals.evidence: status_memory process: valid_mem updated by clr_i/inv_i/new_i using acc_idx

signals.name: valid_mem_rd
signals.function: read-out of valid bit for accessed index
signals.evidence: valid_mem_rd <= valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) in status_memory process

signals.name: tag_mem
signals.evidence: tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= acc_tag when new_i = '1' in tag_memory process

signals.name: tag_mem_rd
signals.function: read-out of tag memory for comparison
signals.evidence: tag_mem_rd <= tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) in tag_memory process

signals.name: data_mem_b0
signals.evidence: data_mem_b0(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0) when we_i(0) = '1' in data_memory process

signals.name: data_mem_b1
signals.evidence: data_mem_b1(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(15 downto 8) when we_i(1) = '1' in data_memory process

signals.name: data_mem_b2
signals.evidence: data_mem_b2(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(23 downto 16) when we_i(2) = '1' in data_memory process

signals.name: data_mem_b3
signals.evidence: data_mem_b3(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(31 downto 24) when we_i(3) = '1' in data_memory process

signals.name: acc_tag
signals.function: address tag field extracted from addr_i
signals.evidence: acc_tag <= addr_i(31 downto 31-(tag_size_c-1))

signals.name: acc_idx
signals.evidence: acc_idx <= addr_i(31-tag_size_c downto 2+offset_size_c)

signals.name: acc_off
signals.function: word offset within block extracted from addr_i
signals.evidence: acc_off <= addr_i(2+(offset_size_c-1) downto 2)

signals.name: acc_adr
signals.function: combined index and offset to address memories
signals.evidence: acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off
